description.narrative: Elcatex, S. de R.L. de C.V. (“ELCATEX”) and San Juan Textiles, S. de R.L. de C.V. are two textile companies that produce fabrics cut them and sew clothing for export.The transaction consists of https://idbinvest.org/en/news-media/idb-invest-keeps-promoting-honduras-sustainable-textile-sector-elcatex-group-financinga long-term senior guaranteed loan for ELCATEX and San Juan Textiles, S. de R.L. de C.V. The Project’s objectives are: (i) to support economic growth and export diversification; (ii) to finance capital investment and working capital for the construction and adaptation of auxiliary civil works, and the acquisition of textile machinery to increase production of the San Juan Textiles plant located at the San Juan Innovation Park Export Processing Zone (“EPZ”) in Choloma; and (iii) to purchase sewing equipment and refurbish sewing plants in Honduras.
